question: The volume of a cube is 1728 cm³ . Find its total surface area (in cm² ).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of cube = a³ = 1728

⇒ Side of cube (a) = 12 cm

Total Surface Area = 6a²

⇒ TSA = 6 × (12)² = 6 × 144 = 864 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 864 cm².**
